narrative.overview: A desk for one person: warm paper, clear ink, one pen colour. Familiarity wins over expression; identity lives in palette, a single type family, hairline borders and a restrained accent.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces, one deep teal accent.
Flat by default: hairline borders instead of shadows.
Plain-language empty states that name the next action.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Teal marks actions, current location and state only. It is never decoration.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any figure that can be compared uses .tabular.

dos: Do override Material through --mat-sys-* tokens in src/styles.css.
Do keep Bootstrap to utility classes, bridged by --bs-* tokens.
Do write empty states that name the next action.
donts: Don't use teal as decoration or on inactive states.
Don't add a colored side-stripe border to rows or alerts.
Don't nest panels or turn every row into a card.
Don't introduce a second font family.
